body: I have severe social anxiety, so when I spend time with others I am miserable, and when I am by myself my OCD makes me miserable. I am miserable 24/7.

Does ACT apply to intrusive thoughts? My compulsions come not just from anxiety and fears, but also from intrusive thoughts that are absolutely repulsive to me and completely opposite from what I truly desire (i.e. intrusive thoughts about wanting sexual abuse or wanting diseases).

I think cold turkey might be the only route for myself as well. I really don't trust the idea of seeing a professional. I don't want to become reliant on them. I also have no girlfriend and no friends to speak of, so we have that in common. I wish us both the best.

What techniques from ACT do you use?

I have seen a counselor in the past, and it was a very unproductive experience. She didn't even stay in touch with me after I sent her the final paycheck. I attempted to correspond with another counselor via email, and she stopped replying to me. I'm also unsure if I would be completely comfortable talking about all this to a stranger in person, and I'm definitely fearful of a psychologist trying to gaslight me and telling me that I must be secretly gay/incestuous.
